It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 9,675 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Yokohama City Open Data
providers.description: Yokohama City Open Data is a municipal government open-data portal for Japan running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 657 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Ulysses (Kaminashi)
providers.description: Kaminashi Inc. (株式会社カミナシ) is a Tokyo-based SaaS company founded in December 2016 under its former corporate name Ulysses Inc. (ユリシーズ株式会社). It builds the Kaminashi frontline-operations DX platform for deskless workers — digital checklists and inspections, equipment maintenance (CMMS), frontline employee management, training and manuals, and reporting — serving food manufacturing, machine manufacturing, logistics, hotels, and building maintenance. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and a16z. The company is ISMS (ISO/IEC 27001) certified and publishes no public developer API surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: Souco
providers.description: Souco (株式会社souco / souco Co., Ltd.) operates a warehouse-sharing marketplace and logistics resource optimization platform in Japan, connecting cargo owners with available space across a nationwide network of 3,000+ warehouses spanning all 47 prefectures. Businesses can secure short- or long-term storage on demand for a wide range of cargo — food ingredients, apparel, machinery, and documents — under ambient, refrigerated, frozen, or temperature-controlled conditions, with pickup and delivery coordination handled by the platform. Alongside the sharing marketplace, souco offers a rental-warehouse search portal, transportation services, and the Optis engine for optimizing logistics networks, plus consulting and DX support for the logistics industry. The company is backed by 500 Global and Sumitomo Corporation's corporate venture arm. souco is a customer-facing logistics platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; its digital surface is a login-gated web application at app.souco.space.

providers.name: Spiber
providers.description: Spiber Inc. is a Japanese biotechnology and advanced-materials company founded in 2007 and headquartered in Tsuruoka, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan. Spiber develops Brewed Protein materials — structural proteins produced by precision fermentation of plant-derived sugars using engineered microbes, then spun into fibers, resins, and films as animal-free, petroleum-free alternatives to silk, wool, cashmere, leather, and synthetic polymers. The company operates fermentation plants in Japan, Thailand, and the United States and supplies apparel, outdoor, automotive, and consumer brands, alongside a research program in synthetic biology, polymer science, and life-cycle assessment. Spiber is a materials manufacturer rather than a software vendor and publishes no developer program, developer portal, SDKs, or product API; the only machine-readable HTTP surface it serves is the read-only WordPress REST content API behind its corporate website.

providers.name: HiJoJo Partners
providers.description: HiJoJo Partners Inc. (HiJoJo Partners株式会社) is a Tokyo-based independent asset management and fintech group, established in November 2017 and registered with the Director of the Kanto Local Finance Bureau (No. 3065) for Type II Financial Instruments Business, Investment Management Business, and Investment Advisory and Agency Business. The firm forms, sells and manages funds that give Japanese institutional and individual investors access to late-stage private and pre-IPO companies, and works to develop Japan's secondary market for unlisted shares. It operates three lines: HiJoJo Prime (in-person advisory for investors with 100M JPY or more in investable assets), HiJoJo.com (an online fund platform for individual investors with 30M JPY or more), and HiJoJo Private Market Solution for institutional investors and startups. HiJoJo joined the Nasdaq Private Market investor consortium in 2024 to expand secondary-market access in Japan. Its investor-facing platform is delivered as an authenticated member web application; the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Zehitomo
providers.description: Zehitomo is a Tokyo-based online marketplace that matches consumers in Japan with local professionals across hundreds of service categories — including photographers, personal trainers, house cleaners, graphic and web designers, videographers, tax accountants, interpreters, construction and repair trades, and business consultants. Clients describe the job they need done and receive quotes and proposals from vetted local pros, while professionals pay to respond to matched leads. Founded in 2015 and backed by 500 Global, Zehitomo runs a consumer-facing web and mobile product; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Leaner Technologies
providers.description: Leaner Technologies (株式会社Leaner Technologies) is a Tokyo-based B2B SaaS company founded on February 22, 2019 by CEO Yusuke Ohira, operating under the mission "調達のスタンダードを刷新し続ける" (continuously renew the standard of procurement). It builds the "Leaner" (リーナー) cloud suite for corporate procurement and purchasing departments: Leaner購買 (purchasing), a purchase-to-pay system covering quotation, approval workflow, ordering, receiving and payment; Leaner sourcing, a quotation and sourcing workspace; Leaner Connect, an SRM supplier-relationship platform; plus procurement BPO and consulting services. The platform aggregates supplier and EC catalogs (including Amazon Business and MonotaRO) into cross-catalog search, and applies AI to classify purchasing data for indirect-spend visibility and cost optimization. The company holds ISMS ISO/IEC 27001:2013 / JIS Q 27001:2014 certification (registration JP21/080659, February 2021). Leaner publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or client SDKs as of this enrichment pass — its integration surface is delivered through partner catalog connections rather than a self-serve API program.

providers.name: Life is Tech
providers.description: Life is Tech, Inc. (ライフイズテック株式会社) is a Tokyo-based education technology company founded on 6 July 2010 by Yusuke Mizuno, delivering digital, programming and AI education to Japanese teenagers, schools, municipalities and employers. Its products are "Life is Tech !" IT camps and year-round schools for junior and senior high school students, "Life is Tech ! Lesson" — a cloud-based information and programming curriculum used by roughly 4,000 public and private schools across some 600 municipalities — "Life is Tech ! Leaders" for university students, "Life is Tech ! Career" digital job-hunting support, and DX Readiness corporate digital-skills training. The company is a certified B Corporation (October 2022, the first Japanese EdTech to certify) and holds the PrivacyMark. Life is Tech sells finished learning products to schools and consumers; it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Hokan
providers.description: Hokan, Inc. (株式会社hokan) is a Japanese InsurTech company that builds hokan®, a cloud-based customer and contract management (CRM) system for insurance agencies and brokerages. The platform consolidates customer and policy information, digitizes proposal and activity workflows, and adds modules for intent capture (意向把握), case management (案件管理), dashboards, accounting/cashiering (出納), and staff management (People). It targets paperless operations, stronger audit and compliance controls, renewal and aftercare tracking, and mobile access for agents. Customers include Orix Life, ANA, Sekisui, and other Japanese insurers and agencies. Hokan is backed by 500 Global. The company exposes API-based website integration for its product but does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: ClassAction
providers.description: ClassAction operates enjin (集団訴訟プラットフォーム enjin), a Japanese class-action / group-litigation platform that connects consumers who have suffered damages from the same party with registered attorneys to pursue collective lawsuits. Victims report their damages, registered lawyers volunteer to take on cases, and participants share legal costs and evidence so that even small-value claimants can afford to litigate. The service launched in May 2018 and is free for users. This is a consumer-facing legal-tech website with no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: App-CM
providers.description: App-CM, Inc. (株式会社アップシーエム) is a Tokyo-based technology company that operates a proprietary video-advertising delivery platform for smartphones, using in-house compression, delivery, and targeting-algorithm technology to serve video ads smoothly in mobile environments. App-CM also develops and publishes consumer mobile apps including FriendQuiz, SunQ, and Shakin. The company is backed by 500 Global and is profiled in the API Evangelist network. It ships a publisher-side iOS/Android video ad SDK, but distributes it only through a sales conversation: there is no public API, developer portal, SDK download, package-registry release, or machine-readable specification, and every /.well-known/ discovery path returns 404. This profile captures its identity, commercial model, and security posture.

providers.name: HERP
providers.description: HERP Inc. (株式会社HERP) is a Japanese HR Tech company whose mission is "採用を変え、日本を強く。" (change recruiting, strengthen Japan). It builds HERP Hire, an AI-era applicant tracking and recruitment management system (ATS) known for "scrum recruiting", alongside ジョブミル (Jobmill) for recruiting agents and HERP Career, a startup-focused job-change service. HERP Hire integrates with job boards and tools such as Zoom, Google Calendar and Slack, and exposes the "HERP Hire API" (generally available from 2026-02-03 to paying customers) for member assignment and application management. HERP was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Kuraseru
providers.description: KURASERU, INC. (株式会社KURASERU) is a Kobe-based Japanese technology company building digital-transformation software for the elderly-care industry. Founded in October 2017 by Taiki Kawahara, a former care worker and hospital medical social worker, the company describes its business as DX promotion for care-related services and system development. Its stated mission is to use technology to lift the administrative burden off care work so that caregivers can spend more of their time with the people they care for, addressing Japan's super-aging society, chronic caregiver shortages, and high turnover. KURASERU is ISO/IEC 27001 certified (IS 716039) and is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation surface, so this is a company profile rather than an API profile.

providers.name: Dinii
providers.description: Dinii (株式会社ダイニー) is a Tokyo-based restaurant-technology SaaS company, founded in June 2018, offering an "All in One Restaurant Cloud" for food-service businesses. Its integrated modules span POS register, customer mobile ordering, mobile self-checkout payment, customer management/CRM (with LINE integration), staff attendance and scheduling, reservation ledger, and management analytics dashboards (daily P&L, labor-cost optimization, QSC monitoring). Dinii reports 3,000+ installed locations and 20 million+ end users, with offices in Tokyo, Osaka, Sapporo, and Nagoya. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Dinii publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Pokelabo
providers.description: Pokelabo (ポケラボ) is a Japanese mobile game development studio founded in 2007 and headquartered in Tokyo. Originally an independent social-game maker, it became a subsidiary of GREE and, as of January 1, 2025, was integrated into WFS (Wright Flyer Studios) under the GREE group. The studio develops and operates smartphone games built on licensed and original intellectual properties, including titles such as SINoALICE and Magia Exedra (Puella Magi Madoka Magica). Pokelabo is a consumer entertainment company and does not expose a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Gojo & Company
providers.description: Gojo & Company, Inc. is a Tokyo-headquartered financial inclusion holding company founded on 4 July 2014 by Taejun Shin and Sanjay Gandhi, with the stated ambition of becoming a "private-sector World Bank". Gojo raises capital from mission-aligned investors and deploys it into microfinance institutions and inclusive financial service providers across South Asia, Southeast Asia, Central Asia, the Caucasus and Africa, supplying not only equity and debt but also management, governance, risk and technology support to its group companies. It runs a Financial Diaries research programme on low-income household cashflows, the Pasio digital financial inclusion initiative, and a non-profit arm, the Gojo Foundation. Gojo is a certified B Corporation and reports under J-GAAP. It is a private company; its equity trades on secondary marketplaces such as Hiive. Gojo publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract — its digital financial infrastructure and cloud core banking work is internal to the group and its partner institutions.

providers.name: Tyffon
providers.description: Tyffon Inc. is a Japanese immersive entertainment company that combines creativity and technology to deliver memorable XR experiences. The studio builds VR, AR, and mixed-reality attractions - including Corridor, Kaiju Haven VR, Floria, and Island Mirrorge MR - operates the Tyffonium attraction brand, licenses its XR content to entertainment venues across Japan, and released the GARA AR platform app. A Techstars portfolio company, Tyffon publishes no public developer portal or API surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: Linc'well
providers.description: Linc'well, Inc. (株式会社Linc'well) is a Tokyo-based healthcare technology company founded in January 2018 whose stated mission is to take healthcare one step further through technology. It operates a healthcare platform that connects medical professionals with patients across online and offline care, organized into three business lines: a telehealth platform licensed to medical institutions, where patients complete everything from booking to consultation on web, smartphone, or tablet, pay by credit card or pay-later, and have medication delivered or dispensed at a local pharmacy; a Smart Clinic clinic-DX service that digitizes core primary-care operations including appointment booking, medical intake, payment, and medical record entry; and a healthcare e-commerce business covering cosmetics, contact lenses, over-the-counter medicines, online medication guidance, and prescription dispensing. Linc'well runs the CLINIC FOR clinic brand and the miteme commerce and pharmacy properties, and is backed by DCM Ventures. It publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; integration is a commercial arrangement with medical institutions.

providers.name: Rakuten Mobile
providers.description: Rakuten Mobile is the Japanese mobile network operator (MNO) of Rakuten Group, headquartered in Setagaya, Tokyo, and Japan's fourth nationwide carrier alongside NTT Docomo, KDDI, and SoftBank. Commercially launched in April 2020 and surpassing 10 million subscribers in December 2025, Rakuten Mobile built and operates the world's first fully cloud-native, end-to-end virtualized mobile network on Open RAN, with 4G population coverage of 99.9% and expanding 5G plus 700 MHz Platinum Band rollout. The same engineering effort spun out into Rakuten Symphony, a B2B business that productizes the Rakuten Mobile playbook as the Symworld platform — a cloud-native operating platform for telcos covering Open RAN (CU/DU/RIC, Symware distributed unit appliance), Symworld Cloud (Kubernetes-based hyperconverged telco cloud / CNP), OSS/BSS, site management, and a marketplace of pre-integrated cloud-native network functions from 50+ vendor partners. Symphony also offers Rakuten CPaaS (carrier-grade SMS, Confirm/OTP, and Short URL APIs running on the Rakuten Mobile network with JWT-authenticated REST endpoints at api.cpaas.symphony.rakuten.net) and Rakuten Communications Platform (RCP) for enterprise private 5G. Public, developer-accessible APIs are concentrated in the CPaaS suite; the Symworld platform APIs themselves are TM Forum-aligned but exposed under commercial engagement rather than a public developer signup.

providers.name: SkyDrive
providers.description: SkyDrive Inc. is a Japanese advanced air mobility manufacturer, founded in July 2018 by members of the CARTIVATOR volunteer project, that develops, manufactures, sells and operates eVTOL (electric vertical take-off and landing) aircraft. Its flagship aircraft, SKYDRIVE (model SD-05), is a compact three-seat electric aircraft in type certification with the Japan Civil Aviation Bureau and in concurrent validation with the US Federal Aviation Administration, and is produced with official manufacturing partner Suzuki Motor Corporation at Suzuki's plant in Iwata, Shizuoka. The company is headquartered in Toyota City, Aichi, with offices in Tokyo, Nagoya, Osaka and Yamaguchi and a US subsidiary, SkyDrive America. SkyDrive is a hardware and aircraft-operations company; it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable interface contract of any kind.

providers.name: Koska
providers.description: KOSKA Corporation (株式会社KOSKA) is a Tokyo-based manufacturing technology company, founded in October 2018, that applies cost accounting and IoT to the Japanese factory floor. Its flagship product GenKan (原価管理自動化サービス) automates cost management for high-mix low-volume manufacturers: RFID and power sensors installed on existing equipment capture work progress and consumption without changing operator behavior, then make processing cost, material cost, and electricity cost visible line by line, feeding real actual-cost figures and KPI setting back to the shop floor and management. A second product, ながら記録 (Nagara Kiroku / "vScribe"), is an AI record-keeping app for manufacturing, construction, and logistics sites — photograph a paper form and AI generates the input form, then operators record hands-free by speaking, with the AI parsing natural speech into structured records, inspections, and reports. KOSKA is led by CEO Kenichiro Sone (Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia 2021) and advised by Hiroshi Obata, former chair of the Japan Cost Accounting Association. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal — it is a sensor-and-SaaS product company, not an API provider.

providers.name: Connected Robotics
providers.description: Connected Robotics Inc. is a Japanese foodtech startup, founded in 2014 by Tetsuya Sawanobori and headquartered in Koganei, Tokyo, that develops specialized robotics and AI systems to automate labor-intensive work across food factories and restaurants. Its product line pairs AI image-processing and robot-control technology with purpose-built machines including the Delibot S plating robot, Delibot X filling robot, AI inspection software, a soft-serve ice-cream robot, and a french-fry cooking robot, targeting labor shortages, productivity, and food safety. The company has raised multiple rounds (including a July 2019 Series A led by Global Brain and a Series B closed in 2023 with strategic investors such as Yaskawa Electric, Hoshizaki, and Mitsubishi HC Capital) and was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company. As a hardware and robotics manufacturer, Connected Robotics publishes no public web API, developer portal, or SDK at this time.

providers.name: Every.tv
providers.description: Every, Inc. (株式会社エブリー, corp.every.tv) is a Tokyo-based Japanese video-media and advertising company that runs consumer lifestyle products including DELISH KITCHEN (recipe video media), retailHUB (a retail promotion and data platform connecting physical stores with digital channels), トモニテ / Tomonite (parenting video media and community), and MOMENTH (a professional video production and social team). Led by CEO Taissei Yoshida and headquartered in Roppongi, Minato, Tokyo, the company approached an IPO on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Every, Inc. publishes an engineering blog and owned media but exposes no public developer API program.

providers.name: Spacee
providers.description: Spacee Inc. (株式会社スペイシー) is a Tokyo-based space-sharing and rental marketplace operator in Japan. Its consumer platforms let people discover and book temporary spaces by the hour: Yoyappin, a booking marketplace for meeting rooms, conference rooms, studios, kitchens and event venues across the Tokyo metropolitan area; THE POINT, a premium coworking and creative "third place" for remote workers; and Office Connect, a nationwide search service for shared offices, rental offices, coworking spaces and virtual offices. Spacee also expands via partnerships (e.g. JR West Japan) and acquisitions (GYYM pay-per-use fitness). It operates as a consumer web and mobile marketplace and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: TokyoOtakuMode
providers.description: Tokyo Otaku Mode (TOM) is a Japan-based e-commerce company and online destination for fans of Japanese pop culture, selling official anime figures, manga merchandise, apparel, and collectibles worldwide through its otakumode.com shop. Grown out of a large social-media following, TOM curates and ships Japanese otaku goods internationally. It runs a private, API-key-gated backend (api.otakumode.com) that powers its storefront, but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specifications, or first-party client SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from live public probes.

providers.name: Shippio
providers.description: Shippio is a Japanese logistics-technology company positioning itself as "Japan's first digital forwarder." It provides cloud-based SaaS for visualizing and streamlining international trade and freight-forwarding operations, combining domain expertise with AI-era digital technology. Its product line includes Shippio Forwarding (a digital forwarding service), Shippio Cargo (trade-management SaaS for shippers/importers-exporters), and Shippio Works (trade-management SaaS for logistics operators), delivered through a multi-sided platform that connects shippers and operators. The company is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Shippio publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or pricing; its APIs are internal platform APIs referenced only in engineering job postings, so this profile is identity-only with no public API surface.

providers.name: enechain
providers.description: enechain operates the largest energy exchange in Japan, offering trading opportunities for wholesale electricity and environmental values across an over-the-counter marketplace that connects energy market participants. Headquartered in Tokyo, the company builds energy markets that help buyers and sellers discover prices, manage risk, and trade power and environmental-value products, under the mission "Building Energy Markets, Coloring Our Society." enechain was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures; it publishes no public developer API or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: EVERSTEEL
providers.description: EVERSTEEL is a University of Tokyo-originated startup building AI image-recognition systems that automate the inspection and grading of steel (iron) scrap for steelmakers. Its flagship product, Tetsu-Navi Inspection AI (鉄ナビ検収AI), uses high-resolution cameras and computer-vision models to grade incoming scrap, detect impurities and hazardous materials, and standardize what was previously a manual, expert-dependent process — advancing steel recycling and reducing CO2 emissions from steel production. The company works with major Japanese steel producers including JFE Steel and Kyoei Steel, and is backed by DCM Ventures, Mitsui & Co., Coreline, and the University of Tokyo.

providers.name: Integral Geometry Science
providers.description: Integral Geometry Science Inc. (IGS) is a Kobe University deep-tech spinout founded on 2 April 2012 by Dr. Kenjiro Kimura, who published the first analytical solution to the inverse problem of wave scattering. IGS turns that mathematics into measurement hardware and imaging software that makes the inside of an object visible without cutting it open: microwave mammography for painless, radiation-free breast cancer screening (designated under Japan's Sakigake scheme), non-destructive current-density imaging for rechargeable battery inspection, walk-through security screening for concealed hazardous materials, and rebar corrosion and fracture inspection for civil infrastructure. The company is headquartered in Kobe, Hyogo, Japan, holds patents across Japan, the United States, China and Europe, and is backed by SBI Investment and Japan's NEDO deep-tech program. IGS sells instruments and diagnostic systems to hospitals, manufacturers and infrastructure operators; it publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK.

providers.name: newmo
providers.description: newmo (newmo株式会社, "ニューモ") is a Japanese mobility company with the mission "移動で地域をカラフルに" — coloring regions through movement. It modernizes regional transportation through a consumer ride-hailing app and taxi service (newmo-taxi.jp), driver recruitment and dispatch, and its newmo Autonomy initiative (newmo.ai), which since 2025 has run Level 4 autonomous-driving taxi trials spanning safety, remote monitoring, operations design, and vehicle integration. newmo is a consumer transportation service rather than a developer/API platform; probing found no public API, developer portal, documentation, or well-known discovery surface. Backed by DCM Ventures.

providers.name: CAPS
providers.description: CAPS Inc. (CAPS株式会社) is a Tokyo-based Healthcare x IT company founded in December 2014 whose mission is to maximize the total amount of happiness through health management (健康経営). CAPS operates a chain of primary-care clinics plus its Doctor365 telemedicine and urgent-care service, provides corporate health-support and wellness programs for employers, runs 24-hour IT-enabled fitness gyms, and delivers health-education programs including a Sesame Street partnership. Headquartered in Roppongi, Minato-ku, Tokyo, the company was seed-funded by 500 Startups Japan (500 Global) in 2018. This API Evangelist profile tracks CAPS as a company; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Excite Japan Co., Ltd. (JASDAQ:3754)
providers.description: Excite Japan Co., Ltd. (エキサイト株式会社), listed on JASDAQ as ticker 3754, is a Tokyo-based internet media and services company founded in August 1997 and headquartered in the Azabudai Hills Mori JP Tower in Minato, Tokyo. It operates the long-running excite.co.jp web portal — offering web, image, and news search, the Excite Blog (exblog.jp) blogging platform, translation and dictionary tools, fortune-telling, recipe, and lifestyle content — alongside the BB.excite broadband/ISP business. Under parent Excite Holdings Co., Ltd., the group organizes its operations into four segments: Platform, Broadband, Medical, and SaaS/DX (including the FanGrowth customer-growth platform). The company does not currently publish a public developer API program or portal; this profile tracks its corporate and web presence within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Kakehashi
providers.description: Kakehashi is a Japanese healthcare technology company digitally transforming the country's roughly 60,000 community pharmacies, a traditionally paper-based sector. Its flagship cloud platform Musubi provides electronic medication history, automated dispensing records, and personalized patient guidance, and is used by more than 14,000 pharmacies across Japan. The product suite extends to Musubi Insight (pharmacy management analytics), Pocket Musubi (patient follow-up app), Musubi AI Stock Management (machine-learning demand forecasting and inventory optimization), and Pharmarket. Kakehashi is backed by investors including 500 Global and Goldman Sachs. No public developer API or platform is currently published.

providers.name: AI Medical Service
providers.description: AI Medical Service Inc. (AIM) is a Tokyo-based med-tech company founded in September 2017 with the mission to save lives worldwide by eliminating gastrointestinal cancers through earlier detection. AIM develops endoscopic AI (artificial intelligence) that assists physicians in real-time diagnostic imaging of the digestive tract, drawing on joint research with more than 100 medical institutions. Its flagship gastroAI family of endoscopic image diagnosis support software has secured regulatory approval in Japan, Singapore, and Thailand, and an earlier FDA approval in the United States. The company distributes its AI on-premise today and is building an in-house cloud platform to broaden access; it currently publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a health-tech lead backed by SoftBank Vision Fund.

providers.name: Ocean Network Express
providers.description: Ocean Network Express (ONE) is a Singapore-headquartered global container liner shipping company formed in 2017 through the integration of the container shipping businesses of three Japanese carriers — Nippon Yusen Kaisha (NYK), Mitsui O.S.K. Lines (MOL), and Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha (K-Line) — with commercial operations launching on 1 April 2018. Operating under the magenta "ONE" brand and the Standard Carrier Alpha Code ONEY, the company runs a fleet exceeding 2,200,000 TEU across 165+ weekly service loops calling at 244+ ports worldwide, making it one of the largest ocean container carriers globally. ONE participates in THE Alliance vessel sharing agreement and offers reefer, dangerous goods, out-of-gauge, and project cargo services alongside standard dry container moves. Its customer-facing digital surface centers on the ONE eCommerce platform (ecomm.one-line.com), which provides cargo tracking, instant quotation via ONE QUOTE (powered by Descartes Kontainers), spot booking, shipping instructions, electronic bill of lading, ePayment, and demurrage/detention inquiry. A partner-facing developer portal exists at developers.one-line.com alongside EDI integration channels, but ONE does not publish a fully open, self-service OpenAPI specification, public SDK, or open-source code at either the github.com/ocean-network-express or github.com/OceanNetworkExpress organizations (both exist with zero public repositories). Tracking, booking, and schedule integrations are most commonly accessed by shippers and BCOs through third-party aggregators (Vizion, Portcast, JSONCargo, Terminal49, Tradlinx) or via DCSA-conformant carrier APIs delivered under commercial agreement.

providers.name: Dverse
providers.description: Dverse is the API Evangelist network profile for Symmetry Dimensions Inc. (株式会社SYMMETRY), a Tokyo-based technology company whose "DVERSE" digital-twin lineage evolved into a portfolio of DX solution services, infrastructure operations and maintenance support (インフラ維持管理支援), and SDTC data services. The company was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the network as an enrichment lead. The branded domain symmetry-dimensions.com now redirects to the company's live site at symmetry-inc.co.jp. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a corporate/marketing site (a Nuxt single-page app on Google Cloud) but no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, CLI, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface — so no machine-readable API artifacts could be harvested. This record therefore carries company identity plus a probed domain-security profile only, and remains a lead awaiting a public API surface.

providers.name: Fact Base Inc.
providers.description: Fact Base Inc. (株式会社Fact Base) is a Japanese manufacturing-technology company on a mission to make manufacturing seamless by driving the digitization of small and mid-sized factories (町工場). Its corporate site presents the company mission and vision for connecting Japan's fragmented small-factory manufacturing base through digital tooling. Surfaced through the API Evangelist network as an Insight Partners portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass no public developer program, API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation is published on the corporate domain.

providers.name: Stailer
providers.description: Stailer (ステイラー) is a retail-commerce platform built by 10X, Inc. (株式会社10X) that lets Japanese supermarket, drugstore, and other retail chains vertically launch and operate their own branded e-commerce and online-grocery services. It provides the consumer storefront apps, order management, in-store picking and fulfillment, and delivery operations that let established brick-and-mortar retailers stand up online shopping quickly. Stailer is a B2B SaaS offering sold through direct enterprise engagement; as of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, documentation portal, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Sumutasu
providers.description: Sumutasu Inc. (株式会社すむたす) is a Japanese property-technology (proptech) company operating under the mission "a society where people can make ideal housing choices" (住まいの理想的な選択ができる社会に). It runs an instant real-estate buying and selling service for used condominiums in Japan, using data and technology to give homeowners a fast, transparent alternative to the traditional brokerage process, alongside an agent-assisted sales offering. The company is backed by 500 Global. Its public presence is a corporate marketing website (About, Services, Members, News, and Careers) built on the Studio.Design no-code platform; no public developer platform, API, SDK, or documentation surface has been found.

providers.name: VisasQ
providers.description: VisasQ Inc. is a Tokyo-headquartered knowledge-sharing and spot-consulting platform that connects companies seeking specialized insight with a global network of roughly 800,000 experts across 190 countries and diverse industries and job functions. Its flagship "ビザスクdirect" service arranges one-on-one expert consultations, and it has launched "AI Scout" to deliver precision expert matches in under five minutes, 24/7. The company operates six global offices with multilingual support and over 600 employees, serving Japan and the United States as primary markets. VisasQ was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or MCP surface; only domain-security posture could be probed.

providers.name: Aculys
providers.description: Aculys Pharma, Inc. is a Japanese clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on neurological and psychiatric diseases where there is high unmet medical need. The company works to eliminate Japan's drug lag and drug loss by bringing innovative medicines already approved in Western markets to Japanese patients as early as possible. Its lead product is Spydia (diazepam nasal spray), Japan's first domestically developed intranasal anti-seizure agent, approved in June 2025 and administrable outside medical facilities. Originally funded by SoftBank Vision Fund (Series C, March 2025), Aculys was acquired by and became part of the Viatris Group in October 2025. Aculys publishes no public developer program, API, or technical documentation surface; this profile is maintained for network completeness and identity.

providers.name: Sansan
providers.description: Sansan, Inc. is a Tokyo-based enterprise SaaS company that builds cloud contact- and business-card management software. Its flagship Sansan platform digitizes and centralizes business cards and customer contact data so sales teams can share information across the organization, surface opportunities, and integrate contact data with external systems. The company also offers the Eight business-card app and Bill One invoice-management product. As of this enrichment pass Sansan does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition on its English or Japanese websites; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: KDDI
providers.description: KDDI Corporation is a Japanese multinational telecommunications operator headquartered in Tokyo, providing mobile, fixed-line, broadband, and enterprise ICT services. KDDI markets its consumer mobile services under the au brand, alongside UQ mobile and povo, and serves enterprise customers globally through KDDI Global and KDDI America. The company operates the KDDI Open API for Developers portal exposing inquiry-gated product APIs including the au PAY Mini App platform, an XR/MEC low-latency application API, a PPM consent management API, and an au mobile Identification Support Service for KYC/identity verification. KDDI also runs the au OPEN DEVICE DEVELOPER SITE for cellular module device certification, and a KDDI Cloud Platform Service knowledge site with developer API references for cloud infrastructure. In 2025 KDDI became an equity partner in Aduna, the GSMA/Ericsson-backed network API venture aggregating CAMARA-aligned carrier APIs (Number Verify, SIM Swap, Quality on Demand, Device Location) across global operators. Public OpenAPI specifications are not openly published; API access is provided through contact/inquiry workflows after partner onboarding.

providers.name: HiCustomer
providers.description: HiCustomer (ハイカスタマー) was a Japanese Customer Success Management (CSM) SaaS built specifically for SaaS companies. Its platform aggregated customer data scattered across BI tools, CRMs, and chat tools to visualize product usage, communication history, revenue, and contract information in one place. Teams used configurable health-score rules to monitor account health across the customer lifecycle, and custom alerts to surface churn and upsell signals at the right moment, with time-series analysis to make customer-success outreach repeatable. The company also offered customer-success consulting, and later pivoted to a digital sales room product, "Arch by HiCustomer". On 2024-09-13 HiCustomer Inc. sold the Arch business to the Tokyo-listed adtech company Geniee, Inc. (TSE 6562), which absorbed it into GENIEE SFA/CRM and rebranded it Geniee DSR. As of this enrichment pass the hicustomer.jp domain no longer resolves to a live site (its authoritative AWS Route 53 zone is delegated but empty) and the product is discontinued; the last archived homepage (Oct 2024) is a STUDIO-built single-page "About the company" placeholder. No public developer API, documentation, SDK, or developer portal was ever published — the Wayback record for hicustomer.jp contains no /api, /docs, /developers, /pricing or /status path at any point in its history.

providers.name: Habitto
providers.description: Habitto is a Tokyo-based fintech company building a mobile financial wellness app for the Japanese market under the banner お金の新習慣 ("new money habits"). The app pairs a high-yield savings account and a cashback debit card with access to human financial advisors who help users save, grow, and protect their money. Habitto is backed by the fintech-focused venture investors Anthemis and QED Investors. This API Evangelist profile has been enriched with company identity, website link properties, and a domain-security probe; Habitto is a consumer-facing product and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Pocket Menu
providers.description: Pocket Menu (Pocket Concierge / ポケットコンシェルジュ) is a Japanese fine-dining restaurant reservation and payment service that curates high-quality restaurants and lets diners book and pay for reservations online. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. The public surface is a consumer web application (Ruby on Rails / React on Rails) at pocket-concierge.jp with no published developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or .well-known discovery documents detected during enrichment.

providers.name: SODA
providers.description: SODA Inc. (株式会社SODA) is a Japanese consumer-technology company that operates SNKRDUNK (スニーカーダンク / スニダン), one of Japan's largest consumer-to-consumer marketplaces for sneakers, trading cards ("トレカ"), apparel, and accessories. The SNKRDUNK app lets users buy and sell collectible and secondary-market goods with professional in-house authentication (真贋鑑定 by プロ鑑定士) and a full purchase-protection / compensation guarantee, alongside a buyback service. SODA is a portfolio company of the SoftBank Vision Fund. As a consumer marketplace app, SODA publishes no public developer program or API at this time; this profile captures the company's public identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: P2P, Inc.
providers.description: P2P, Inc. is the Japanese insurtech startup behind justInCase, a smartphone-first micro-insurance (少額短期保険) provider offering short-term, on-demand consumer coverage such as smartphone protection, cancer insurance, and peer-to-peer risk-sharing products. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. As of this enrichment pass its justincase.jp domain returns a 307 redirect to Sony Shoutan Insurance (sony-sasti.jp), a Sony Financial Group micro-insurer, indicating the business has been absorbed. No public developer API, documentation, SDK, developer portal, or technical integration surface was found on either the original or the successor domain.

bands.label: Not Yet Rated
bands.blurb: Providers we have not scored yet — unknown, not zero.

providers.name: DCM Ventures
providers.description: DCM Ventures (formerly Doll Capital Management, and commonly known as DCM) is an early-stage venture capital firm founded in 1996 by Dixon Doll, a former Accel partner, and David Chao, and headquartered at 2420 Sand Hill Road in Menlo Park, California with additional offices in Beijing and Tokyo. DCM was among the first Silicon Valley firms to build a cross-border, US-Asia investing practice, and typically leads early-stage rounds with checks in the roughly $1M-$5M range, deploying capital into a small group of category-defining companies each year rather than investing broadly. The firm's thesis has evolved from its original focus on communications and semiconductors toward consumer internet and SaaS, and today centers on vertical SaaS, fintech, cross-border innovation, and AI-native applications across the United States, China, Japan, and Southeast Asia. As of 2025 DCM manages approximately $4.5 billion in assets and reports 400+ portfolio companies, 35+ unicorns, and over $150 billion in aggregate market value, with notable investments including SoFi, Bill.com, Kuaishou, Matterport, 51job, Careem, and Sansan.
